Active categories (nested, each with its full attribute list and `effectiveTax`), brands, sizes, colours, GST rates and HSN codes. Only for users with a vendor account; anyone else gets VENDOR_NOT_FOUND.

No login needed. Only visible products: approved, from an approved vendor, in an active category, with an active variant and a published photo. Filters: `q`, `categoryId` or `categorySlug` (sub-categories included), `brandId`, `size`, `colour` (comma-separated, any of them), `minPrice` and `maxPrice` (paise, on the card price), `hasDiscount=true`, `inStock=true` (only products with stock), and `attr.<key>=<value>[,<value>]` for attributes an admin marked filterable. At most 20 filter values in one request. Sorting: `relevance` (with q), `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `newest`. The card price is the cheapest active variant with its own MRP; the discount is rounded down. Each card has `inStock`; out-of-stock products stay listed. `facets` counts brands, sizes, colours, price buckets and availability (in stock / out of stock), each with every filter applied except its own. No quantity is ever returned.

No login needed. Live content, attributes with labels, every photo size, active variants, the category path, brand and vendor. Availability: the product and each variant have `inStock` and `lowStock` (in stock but at or below the low-stock threshold); never a quantity. A product that is not visible (draft, submitted, rejected, unpublished, a suspended vendor, an inactive category, no active variant) is PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND. Changes waiting in a revision never appear.
No login needed. Up to 5 products whose words start with what was typed, and up to 3 categories and 3 brands that have visible products.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What the customer typed so far (up to 100 characters)

With `categoryId` the example uses that category's slug and has one `attr.<key>` column per attribute of the category and its parent categories, and its sizes, colours, brand and HSN code come from the active lists, so it can be uploaded as it is. Stock is not a column (Area 4). See GET /vendors/me/imports/columns for every rule. Errors: VENDOR_NOT_FOUND, CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND.

Every column of the import file: name, whether it describes the product (read from its first row) or the variant (every row), required or optional, accepted format, an example and the rules; then the limits (rows and bytes per file, uploads per hour, variants per product, how long a preview can be confirmed) and notes. post.description: Multipart `file`: a comma-separated UTF-8 CSV with a header row (at most IMPORT_MAX_ROWS rows and IMPORT_MAX_BYTES). Every row is checked with the same rules as creating products and variants one by one; nothing is created. The answer lists each product (valid or not, with its problems) and each row (its line in the file and its problems by column), and `expiresAt`: confirm before then. The file itself is not kept. At most IMPORT_UPLOADS_PER_HOUR uploads per vendor per hour. Errors: FILE_REQUIRED, FILE_TOO_LARGE, IMPORT_FILE_INVALID (not UTF-8, not a CSV, a missing, unknown or repeated column, no rows, too many rows), UPLOAD_RATE_LIMITED, VENDOR_NOT_FOUND, VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED.

Works once per import, and only until `expiresAt` (24 hours after the upload). Photos are added to each draft afterwards. Errors: IMPORT_NOT_FOUND, IMPORT_STATE_INVALID (already confirmed, or nothing valid), IMPORT_EXPIRED, VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED.
post.summary: Confirm: create the valid products as drafts

Each row has `available`, the vendor’s own `lowStockThreshold` (null = default), the `effectiveThreshold` and the `state`. Works for a vendor in any status. A user without a vendor gets VENDOR_NOT_FOUND. Another vendor’s variant, an unknown id and a malformed id are VARIANT_NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: in_stock: above the threshold; low: 1 up to the threshold; out: 0

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a SKU or product title (up to 100 characters)

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Only the variants of this product

get.summary: Your stock, one row per variant

get.description: Over your active variants: how many there are, how many are in stock, low and out, the total units, and the default threshold (LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD).

put.description: `quantity` is what can be sold from now (0 up to MAX_STOCK_PER_VARIANT, default 1,000,000); units held for unpaid orders are already out of it. The same number again changes nothing. Recorded in the history and the audit log. Errors: STOCK_INVALID. Only an approved vendor can change stock (VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED). A user without a vendor gets VENDOR_NOT_FOUND. Another vendor’s variant, an unknown id and a malformed id are VARIANT_NOT_FOUND.

patch.description: `lowStockThreshold`: low at or below this many units; 0 = never low; `null` = the default (LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD, 5). Audited; not a stock movement. Errors: STOCK_INVALID. Only an approved vendor can change stock (VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED). A user without a vendor gets VENDOR_NOT_FOUND. Another vendor’s variant, an unknown id and a malformed id are VARIANT_NOT_FOUND.

post.description: `delta` is added (or, when negative, removed); the result must stay between 0 and the maximum. An optional `note` is kept in the history. Errors: STOCK_INVALID. Only an approved vendor can change stock (VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED). A user without a vendor gets VENDOR_NOT_FOUND. Another vendor’s variant, an unknown id and a malformed id are VARIANT_NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Newest first: `delta`, `balanceAfter`, `reason` (initial, vendor_set, vendor_adjust, reserve, release, expire, retake, restock), `note`, `actorId`, `createdAt`. Works for a vendor in any status. A user without a vendor gets VENDOR_NOT_FOUND. Another vendor’s variant, an unknown id and a malformed id are VARIANT_NOT_FOUND.

post.description: 1 to INVENTORY_BULK_MAX (default 500) items `{sku, quantity}`, each SKU once. All or nothing: any unknown or repeated SKU or bad quantity refuses the whole request with STOCK_BULK_INVALID and every problem in `error.details.failures` (index, sku, code, message). Answers how many changed and every item after the update. More than the limit: VALIDATION_FAILED. Only an approved vendor can change stock (VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED). A user without a vendor gets VENDOR_NOT_FOUND. Another vendor’s variant, an unknown id and a malformed id are VARIANT_NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Admins, moderators and support. Newest first, with `sourceType` and `sourceId` (the reservation, order item or return item behind a movement), `vendorId` and `actorId`. Unknown variant: VARIANT_NOT_FOUND. Other users get 403.

post.description: For one of your variants (any product status; it takes effect at once, like a price change). `salePricePaise` must be strictly below the variant’s current price (SALE_PRICE_INVALID). The window is half open: active from `startsAt` up to, not including, `endsAt`; the start may be at most 5 minutes in the past and the sale at most SALE_MAX_DURATION_DAYS (90) long (SALE_WINDOW_INVALID). Overlapping another sale of the same variant that is not cancelled: SALE_OVERLAP. Another vendor’s or an unknown variant: VARIANT_NOT_FOUND. Only an approved vendor (VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED). Audited.

patch.description: admin and marketing. The code never changes. A marketplace coupon’s financial terms and lists lock once it has been used (dates and limits stay editable). A vendor or split coupon that is active, used or made from a request can only change in ways that keep or lower the vendor’s exposure: a later start, an earlier end, a higher minimum, lower limits (COUPON_LOCKED otherwise, naming the term). Widening a never-used admin-created coupon clears the vendor’s acceptance and returns it to `pending_vendor`. A limit below the uses held: COUPON_LIMIT_BELOW_USAGE.

post.description: admin and marketing, on a submitted request only (COUPON_REQUEST_STATE_INVALID), never on one you submitted yourself (COUPON_REQUEST_SELF_REVIEW). Creates the coupon from exactly the submitted terms, vendor-funded, pending the vendor’s acceptance of the final terms. Optional `code` (default: the proposed code; one is required) and `note`. Rechecks the vendor (VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED), dates and ceilings (COUPON_REQUEST_INVALID); a taken code is COUPON_CODE_TAKEN.

admin and marketing, on a submitted request only (COUPON_REQUEST_STATE_INVALID), never on one you submitted yourself (COUPON_REQUEST_SELF_REVIEW). `note` is required: the vendor sees it as feedback, revises and submits again.

Vendor-funded only: you pay all of the discount, on your own lines. Required: `startsAt`, `endsAt` (at most 90 days apart), `usageLimit`, `perUserLimit` (at most the usage limit), and `maxDiscountPaise` for a percent coupon. Ceilings: at most ₹5,000 per use (the fixed value or the percent cap), at most 10,000 uses, and at most ₹5,00,000 total exposure (usage limit x per-use maximum). Products must be your own (COUPON_REQUEST_PRODUCT_INVALID). Any other problem: COUPON_REQUEST_INVALID. The answer shows `maxExposurePaise`. At most 10 open requests (COUPON_REQUEST_LIMIT). Only the owner of an approved vendor (VENDOR_NOT_APPROVED). Another vendor’s request, an unknown id and a malformed id are COUPON_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Answers the cart view: lines grouped by seller, each with its effective `unitPricePaise` (the sale price while a sale runs), the `mrpPaise`, `strikeThroughPaise` (the MRP, only when the price is below it), `onSale`, `saleEndsAt`, `lineTotalPaise` and a `status` (ok, low_stock, insufficient_stock, out_of_stock, unavailable with a `reason`). Never a stock quantity. Lines that cannot be bought stay in the cart, flagged, and are left out of the totals. `canCheckout` is true when the cart is not empty and every line is ok or low_stock. Send `couponCode` to preview a coupon: a coupon that cannot apply is reported in `coupon` with `applied: false`, a `reason` and a customer `message`, never as an error.

info.title: Marketplace API
info.description: India-first multi-vendor fashion marketplace. Every error is { error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }. All routes except the public Auth ones and /health need a bearer token.

phone.description: Any common way of writing an Indian mobile number. Normalised by the service.

sellerType.description: Required to submit, not to apply.

contactEmail.description: Business contact email. Required to submit, not to apply.

gstin.description: Send null to remove the GSTIN.

sellerType.description: Locked after approval, like the legal name and GSTIN.

termsVersion.description: The vendor terms version the owner has just accepted. Must equal the current version (GET /vendors/me shows it as `requiredTermsVersion`).

label.description: Shown to users; "5%" when left out.

slug.description: Taken from the name when left out.

attributeSchema.description: Must be a list (otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED); its contents are checked by the category rules, which report every problem at once (ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA_INVALID).

slug.description: Taken from the name when left out.

attributes.description: Values by attribute key, for the attributes of the category and its ancestors.

sizeCode.description: A code from the size list.

colourCode.description: A code from the colour list.

pricePaise.description: Checked by the variant rules together with the MRP (PRICE_INVALID).

imageIds.description: Every photo id of the product, in the new order. The first one is the cover.

altText.description: Describes the photo for screen readers; null clears it.

seenUpdatedAt.description: The product's `updatedAt` (or the detail's `seenUpdatedAt`) as you saw it: if it changed since, REVIEW_STALE.

confirmTax.description: Required (true) when the version under review has a tax classification declared by the vendor.

q.description: Search text (up to 100 characters): title, description, brand and category names, with typo tolerance

categoryId.description: A category; its sub-categories are included. Not together with categorySlug

categorySlug.description: A category by its slug; its sub-categories are included. Not together with categoryId

size.description: Size codes, comma-separated (products with an active variant in any of them)

colour.description: Colour codes, comma-separated (products with an active variant in any of them)

minPrice.description: Lowest card price in paise (the cheapest active variant), inclusive

maxPrice.description: Highest card price in paise, inclusive

hasDiscount.description: true: only products whose card price is below its MRP. false (or absent): no filter

inStock.description: true: only products with stock (some active variant has units). false (or absent): no filter; out-of-stock products are listed too

sort.description: Default: relevance with a search text, otherwise newest. relevance without q is newest

quantity.description: Units that can be sold from now: 0 up to MAX_STOCK_PER_VARIANT (default 1,000,000). Not the shelf count: units held by active reservations are already out of it.

delta.description: Units to add (positive) or remove (negative); not 0. The result must stay between 0 and the maximum.

note.description: Why (up to 200 characters), kept in the history

lowStockThreshold.description: Low at or below this many units; 0 means never low; null goes back to the default (LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD, 5)

sku.description: One of your SKUs (any letter case)

quantity.description: The new quantity, as in a single set

items.description: 1 to INVENTORY_BULK_MAX (default 500) items; each SKU once

salePricePaise.description: Whole paise, more than 0 and strictly below the variant’s current price

startsAt.description: When the sale starts (ISO 8601). At most 5 minutes in the past

endsAt.description: When the sale ends (ISO 8601); the sale is no longer active at this instant. At most SALE_MAX_DURATION_DAYS (90) after the start

reason.description: Why (up to 500 characters). Default: "Cancelled by the vendor"

discountType.description: percent (value in basis points, 1 to 10000) or fixed (value in paise)

value.description: Basis points for percent (1000 = 10%), whole paise for fixed

maxDiscountPaise.description: The most one order can save, in paise (the cap). null = no cap

minCartPaise.description: Minimum total of the eligible lines, in paise. Default 0

startsAt.description: When it starts (ISO 8601). null = at once

endsAt.description: When it ends; no longer usable at this instant. null = no end

usageLimit.description: Total uses allowed. null = no limit (a 100% coupon needs one)

perUserLimit.description: Uses allowed per customer. null = no limit

excludeSaleItems.description: When true, lines on a vendor sale are not discounted. Default false

categoryIds.description: Limit to these categories and their sub-categories (up to 50). [] = no restriction

productIds.description: Limit to these products (up to 50); with categories, a line must match both. [] = no restriction

code.description: 3 to 20 characters A-Z 0-9 - _ (stored in capitals; matching ignores case). Cannot change later

fundedBy.description: marketplace, vendor or split. vendor and split need vendorId and start pending the vendor’s acceptance

vendorId.description: Required for vendor and split. For marketplace it only limits the coupon to that vendor’s lines

marketplaceShareBps.description: For split only: the marketplace’s share in basis points (1 to 9999)

discountType.description: percent (value in basis points, 1 to 10000) or fixed (value in paise)

value.description: Basis points for percent (1000 = 10%), whole paise for fixed

maxDiscountPaise.description: The most one order can save, in paise (the cap). null = no cap

minCartPaise.description: Minimum total of the eligible lines, in paise. Default 0

startsAt.description: When it starts (ISO 8601). null = at once

endsAt.description: When it ends; no longer usable at this instant. null = no end

usageLimit.description: Total uses allowed. null = no limit (a 100% coupon needs one)

perUserLimit.description: Uses allowed per customer. null = no limit

excludeSaleItems.description: When true, lines on a vendor sale are not discounted. Default false

categoryIds.description: Limit to these categories and their sub-categories (up to 50). [] = no restriction

productIds.description: Limit to these products (up to 50); with categories, a line must match both. [] = no restriction

termsDigest.description: The termsDigest you were shown. If the terms changed since, acceptance is refused (COUPON_TERMS_CHANGED)

code.description: The final code. Default: the proposed code (one of the two is required)

note.description: Feedback the vendor will see (up to 2000 characters)

proposedCode.description: A code you would like (3 to 20 characters A-Z 0-9 - _). Staff may choose another

note.description: Why you want it (up to 2000 characters)

value.description: Basis points for percent (1000 = 10%), whole paise for fixed (at most ₹5,000 per use)

maxDiscountPaise.description: Required for percent: the most one order can save, in paise (at most ₹5,000)

minCartPaise.description: Minimum total of the eligible lines, in paise. Default 0

startsAt.description: When it starts (at most 5 minutes in the past when submitted)

endsAt.description: When it ends: at most VENDOR_COUPON_MAX_DURATION_DAYS (90) after the start

usageLimit.description: Total uses (at most 10,000; usageLimit x the per-use maximum at most ₹5,00,000)

perUserLimit.description: Uses per customer: at least 1 and at most usageLimit (required)

excludeSaleItems.description: Leave lines on sale out. Default false

categoryIds.description: Limit to these categories and their sub-categories (up to 50)

productIds.description: Limit to these products of yours (up to 50); with categories, a line must match both

quantity.description: Units to add (added to what is already in the cart, up to CART_MAX_QUANTITY_PER_LINE, 10)
The new quantity, 1 up to CART_MAX_QUANTITY_PER_LINE (10). To remove a line, delete it.
